result.instructions: Tools for Tinybird, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which Data Sources are in our workspace, and what schema does each one have?"; "Run the top_pages endpoint for the last 7 days and show the rows."; "Count the page views per day with a read-only SQL query.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Tinybird data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run tinybird_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run tinybird_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run tinybird_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. tinybird_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: tinybird_list_datasources
tools.title: List Data Sources
tools.description: List the Data Sources (tables) in the workspace. Tinybird API: GET /v0/datasources.

tools.name: tinybird_get_datasource
tools.title: Get Data Source
tools.description: Show one Data Source: its schema, engine and settings. Tinybird API: GET /v0/datasources/{name}.

name.description: Name of the Data Source, Pipe or endpoint, as the list tools show it.

tools.name: tinybird_list_pipes
tools.title: List Pipes
tools.description: List the Pipes in the workspace, with their nodes and which node is published as an endpoint. Tinybird API: GET /v0/pipes.

tools.name: tinybird_get_pipe
tools.title: Get Pipe
tools.description: Show one Pipe: its SQL nodes, parameters and endpoint status. Tinybird API: GET /v0/pipes/{name}.

name.description: Name of the Data Source, Pipe or endpoint, as the list tools show it.

tools.name: tinybird_run_endpoint
tools.title: Run endpoint
tools.description: Run a published Tinybird endpoint (a Pipe with an enabled node) with its parameters and return the rows. Tinybird API: GET /v0/pipes/{name}.json.

name.description: Name of the Data Source, Pipe or endpoint, as the list tools show it.

params.description: Endpoint parameters as name/value pairs, for example {"days": 7}.

tools.name: tinybird_run_sql
tools.title: Run read-only SQL
tools.description: Run one read-only SQL query (SELECT or WITH ... SELECT) against the Data Sources and Pipes of the workspace. Returns JSON. Write statements are refused. Tinybird Query API: POST /v0/sql.

sql.description: One SELECT or WITH query. A FORMAT clause is added when you leave it out (FORMAT JSON).

tools.name: tinybird_list_jobs
tools.title: List jobs
tools.description: List the recent Tinybird jobs (imports, appends, copies and other background work). Tinybird API: GET /v0/jobs.

tools.name: tinybird_get_job
tools.title: Get job
tools.description: Show one job: its kind, status and error, if any. Tinybird API: GET /v0/jobs/{id}.

job_id.description: Job id, as tinybird_list_jobs shows it.

tools.name: tinybird_send_events
tools.title: Send events
tools.description: Append rows to a Data Source. Pass one JSON object per line (NDJSON). Each call appends the rows once and is never retried, so a repeated call adds duplicate rows. Tinybird Events API: POST /v0/events?name=<datasource>.

datasource.description: Name of the Data Source that receives the rows.

events.description: NDJSON: one JSON object per line.

prompts.title: Get started with Tinybird
prompts.description: What you can do with Tinybird here, with example requests to try.
